> 🟠 **Mastercard-funded discount on this response.** SmartPay found an exact tie and Mastercard funded the difference to win it:

- **ICON Park: Orlando Eye observation wheel, family of four** — Citi Strata Premier Card earns $7.40 more in guaranteed value and $13.32 more in estimated rewards than Chase Sapphire Preferred on this purchase. (Mastercard card-linked offer: Orlando Eye — $7.40)
- **Airport transport, scheduled Lyft both ways** — Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select World Elite Mastercard earns $28.00 more in guaranteed value than Chase Sapphire Preferred on this purchase. (10% off scheduled Lyft airport rides — $18.00; Mastercard card-linked offer: Lyft — $10.00)
